testsuite.name: com.aquinofroilan.tessera.domain.auth.controller.SessionControllerTest

testcase.name: GET sessions should return empty list when no sessions()
GET sessions should return list with current session indicator()
DELETE session by id should return 200 on success()
DELETE session should return 403 without session delete permission()
GET sessions should return 403 without session read permission()
DELETE session by id should return 400 when revoking the current session()
DELETE session by id should return 404 for non-owned session()
DELETE sessions should revoke others and return 200()
